name: openworld-moments
description: Local-first desktop tool that turns console gameplay captures into searchable sessions and editable stories.

scripts.format: pnpm run format:ts && pnpm run format:rs && pnpm run format:py
scripts.format:py: uv run --locked --directory services/media-worker ruff format . && uv run --locked --directory packages/contracts/python ruff format .
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:check:ts && pnpm run format:check:rs && pnpm run format:check:py
scripts.format:check:py: uv run --locked --directory services/media-worker ruff format --check . && uv run --locked --directory packages/contracts/python ruff format --check .
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ts && pnpm run lint:rs && pnpm run lint:py && pnpm run lint:licenses
scripts.lint:py: uv run --locked --directory services/media-worker ruff check . && uv run --locked --directory packages/contracts/python ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:ts && pnpm run typecheck:py
scripts.typecheck:py: uv run --locked --directory services/media-worker mypy && uv run --locked --directory packages/contracts/python mypy
scripts.test: pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:rs && pnpm run test:py
scripts.test:py: uv run --locked --directory services/media-worker pytest && uv run --locked --directory packages/contracts/python pytest
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --locked --directory packages/contracts/python python scripts/generate.py && pnpm --filter @openworld-moments/contracts run generate
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run contracts:check
scripts.build:windows: pnpm --filter @openworld-moments/desktop run tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.packaged.conf.json --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
